children: said Saturday its board ​approved the company's participation in a new Brazilian government subsidy program for diesel producers designed to support diesel supply during instability linked to geopolitical disruptions.
The program provides one real per liter (~$0.19) of diesel for 30 days, with the possibility of extending the measure for another 30 days.
, the new program can operate alongside an earlier diesel subsidy which provides R$1.12/liter, providing another buffer against sharp international fuel price movements.

The company also said it received 448M reais in gasoline subsidy payments linked to sales in the July 16-31 period, raising its cumulative receipts from government fuel-support measures to $9.9B reais, or ~$1.9B.

announced an increase in diesel prices ​to distributors by an average of one real/liter while also giving a discount of the ​same amount; as a result, its prices to distributors ​remain unchanged while the company benefits from the subsidy.

title: Petrobras board backs new diesel subsidy program as fuel payments hit $1.9B
